site: Velo Ribeira, a fictional bike rental, tour and shop business in Porto, served by testsite/server.py
scoring: Analyze each start page separately. 'pages' lists the start pages a link appears on; '*' means the shared header or footer, which is on every start page.
A defect counts as found if the report has a finding for its URL whose rule is in 'accepted_rules'.
A decoy is a false positive if the report has an error or warning finding for it. An info-level 'redirect' finding is fine.
Every link on a start page that is not listed here works, so any error or warning finding for one of them is also a false positive.

'linkchecker_flags' says whether LinkChecker reports the link as invalid when run as: linkchecker --check-extern -r1 --timeout 10 <start page> (10 s matches the agent's HTTP client). For a defect, true means the static tool finds it; for a decoy, false means it correctly leaves it alone.
URLs assume the server runs on port 80. On another port, add the port to the host before comparing.
